verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the shell-integration docs: kitty can jump between previous prompts in the scrollback and open the last command's output in less, where it could presumably be searched. There is no documented built-in scrollback search or match-to-match navigation. missing for 10: native scrollback search, jump-to-next/previous-match navigation, docs describing search keybindings or actions, hands-on or community corroboration of search speed.
